criteria.demonstration: Actual retained pair elimination promotes before addition and preserves scalar output on wrong tag. Every old operation has an explicit TEXT migration rule; borrowed source bytes are copied before mutation and a source-policy clone replaces a destination-policy owner only after success. Text length, embedded zero and empty-text-versus-EMPTY are separate states.

Old destination survives, including an input suffix borrowing its payload; self-copy/move call no callback, moves empty the source, policy transfer drops the old context once, and repeated drop is harmless.
